paragraphs: R' Hanina bar Luwai. See the entry R' Hana bar Luwai.[^1]

notes.text: Both patronymics have לואי, retained as Luwai rather than normalized to Levi or Lewi. Hanina (חנינא) and Hana (חנא) remain distinct; both abbreviated titles remain R'.
